name: pumi-agents
description: Coding agents in pumi's tabs: Claude Code, Codex, pi and more open from the + menu, in their own terminal or in a GUI. pumi sees when each one works or waits on you, and each one is told about the workspace around it.

images.alt: A Claude Code session as a chat: messages, a tool call, a permission card and the prompt

modes.label: Modes
modes.desc: How each agent opens from the + menu, by its id: `off` (left out, and its hook taken out), `terminal` (its own screen), or `gui` (a chat tab that runs it over its SDK or ACP). Settings → Agents sets it; an agent left out has its default.

prefer.label: Open agents in
prefer.desc: Sets every agent at once (those Off stay off): its terminal, or its GUI where it has one. A GUI runs the agent over its SDK or over ACP, this one first when it has both.

permissions.label: Answer permission prompts in pumi
permissions.desc: An agent's permission prompts come to pumi, where the chat and any client can answer them; unanswered in two minutes, the agent asks in its own prompt. Claude Code only.

context.label: Tell agents about my workspace
context.desc: Each agent learns which sessions, panes and tabs are open around it, so it can use them.

hooks.label: Connect agents to pumi
hooks.desc: Put a hook in each agent's own config (e.g. ~/.claude/settings.json) so pumi sees its session and when it works, waits on you or is done, and can bring it back with its tab. Off: every hook is taken out.

commands.title: Agents: flip the focused tab between the terminal and the chat
Agents: continue this agent in its GUI
Agents: continue this chat tab's session in the agent's terminal

traits.title: Agent
traits.desc: A tab whose agent has the plugin's hook: the agent's id (`claude`), set by the hook. `session` is its own session id, `model` its model, `transcript` its session file's absolute path, `accepts` what it takes besides typing (`["queue"]`: a queued prompt at its stop hook), and `conversation` the plugin that serves its conversation (`conversation.read`, `.send`, `.changed`).
